reading_note: The teaching describes the final three works of the Lord's restoration: (1) the formation of a new natural mind illuminated by truth, (2) the binding of falsity-from-evil within itself, and (3) the eternal separation of those who confirmed themselves in evil from those who received good. The arc moves from the establishment of a regenerated ground, through the conquest of the opposing love, to the permanent fixing of the great gulf — a state from which there is no further willing to be otherwise, because each side has reached its final form.
